# Engineering method

Use this guide when the user explicitly invokes `/engineering-method`. It provides Ada's reference material without automatically applying it to other agents. Read only the material relevant to the current request:

- [Collaboration and planning](references/collaboration-and-planning.md): exploratory conversation, feedback, decisions, and phase boundaries.
- [Test-driven design](references/test-driven-design.md): using scenarios and testability as design feedback.
- [Architecture and decisions](references/architecture-and-decisions.md): lifecycle awareness, tradeoffs, evidence, and preserving intent.
- [Handoffs](references/handoffs.md): human-readable implementation briefs, naming, and provenance.

Summarize only relevant principles and cite the actual project evidence or reference used. Do not assume that speculative examples are user-approved requirements. A direct instruction from the user and the active project's applicable instructions take precedence where appropriate.
